c1-chain.title: Chaining Clauses
c1-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + و + نتيجة (verb + because + reason + and + result)
c1-chain.explanation: At this level, sentences stop being single statements and start chaining reason and result together: لازم أروح البيت الحين لأن تعبان كثير، وأبغى أشرب شاي (I have to go home now because I'm very tired, and I want to drink tea). Each clause stays simple -- the skill is stringing 2-3 of them together fluently, the way real spoken Gulf Arabic naturally runs on.
c1-chain.fact: Long chained sentences like this are exactly how Gulf Arabic speakers naturally tell a story or explain a decision out loud -- rarely as one flat statement, almost always as a little chain of "this, because that, so I did this."
